postings.conferenceName: Neurology 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 13th Edition of International Conference on Neurology, Brain Health & Neurological Disorders
postings.conferenceText: Rome and Online, from June 24-26, 2027 - the 13th Edition of International Conference on Neurology, Brain Health & Neurological Disorders hosts the international neurology community for three days of scholarly programme. Formatted as a CPD-accredited three-day meeting at NH Villa Carpegna, Rome (June 24-26, 2027), the 13th Edition of International Conference on Neurology, Brain Health & Neurological Disorders (Neurology 2027) gives the international neurology community a working forum for scholarly briefings, clinical sessions, and case-based discussion. Every session is directed at supporting neurologists, neuroscience researchers, and clinical practitioners in refreshing their working knowledge. Coverage at this Neurodegenerative Diseases Conference 2027 reaches across Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, stroke management, neurodegenerative diseases, brain tumors and neuro-oncology, epilepsy and seizure disorders, AI in neurology, neuroimmunology, clinical neurology, neuropharmacology, cognitive and memory disorders, neurological interventions, pediatric neurology, neurological rehabilitation, neuroimaging, translational neurology, and trauma and neurocritical care. CPD certificates of attendance are provided to attending delegates and presenters; oral or poster abstracts that pass review add further academic recognition. Within the Neurology Conferences 2027 calendar, this meeting operates a tiered registration model - abstract submission for speakers and presenters, standard or early-bird rates for delegates and listeners. Reach us at: E-mail: [email protected] Phone: +1 (702) 988-2320 WhatsApp: +1 (540) 709-1879 Website: https://neurology.magnusconferences.com/ Neurology Conference 2027 | International Neurology Conference 2027 | Neurology Research Conference 2027 | Neurology Summit 2027 | Neurology Conference Rome | Neurology Symposium 2027 | Neurology Conferences 2027 | Brain Health Conference 2027

postings.conferenceName: 13th International Conference on 3D Vision 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 13th International Conference on 3D Vision
postings.conferenceText: 3DV 2026 is the 13th International Conference on 3D Vision, an international platform for advances in 3D computer vision and graphics. The conference brings together work on sensing, representation, reconstruction, modeling, analysis, rendering, interaction, and applications related to 3D visual understanding. The 2026 edition will be held in Vancouver as an in-person event and continues the 3DV series as a focused venue for geometry- and 3D-centric vision research. 3D computer vision and graphics; optical sensors and 3D acquisition; geometric modeling and representations; 3D reconstruction; visualization and rendering; analysis and interaction with 3D data; applications of 3D vision in science, engineering, and real-world systems.

postings.conferenceName: Entrepreneurial Learning, Arts and Creativity for Inclusive and Sustainable Urban Futures 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 3rd UNIC Thematic Conference
postings.conferenceText: The 3rd UNIC Thematic Conference brings together the perspectives of UNIC’s Thematic Line 5 (Entrepreneurial Learning for Innovation) and Thematic Line 7 (Arts, Culture and Creativity), while drawing on the transversal contribution of Thematic Line 1 (Superdiversity). Hosted by Ruhr University Bochum, the conference focuses on the role of creativity, culture, entrepreneurship, participation, and innovation in shaping the futures of post-industrial cities. We invite proposals, from scholars, independent researchers, students, civil society actors, practitioners and policymakers. Submissions may include individual papers, thematic panels, workshops, book presentations, stakeholder roundtables, artist talks and student-led activies. Both theoretical and empirical work are welcome from applicants at all stages of their career. Submission deadline 14 September 2026

postings.conferenceName: 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems
postings.conferenceText: AAMAS 2026 is the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems, the flagship conference of the field and one of the largest and most influential venues on agent technologies. The conference brings together work on autonomous agents, multiagent interaction, coordination, decision making, and real-world agent applications. The 2026 edition is hosted in Paphos, Cyprus, with tutorials, doctoral consortium, and workshops surrounding the main conference dates. The conference spans autonomous agents, multiagent systems, strategic interaction, coordination and cooperation, planning and decision making, learning in multiagent settings, social and economic aspects of agents, robotics and embodied agents, agent-based simulation, and practical applications of agent technologies.

postings.conferenceName: 18th Asian Conference on Computer Vision 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 18th Asian Conference on Computer Vision
postings.conferenceText: ACCV 2026 is the 18th Asian Conference on Computer Vision, a leading biennial international conference sponsored by the Asian Federation of Computer Vision. The conference brings together the computer vision community to discuss foundational advances, learning-based methods, and application-driven innovations in visual understanding. The 2026 edition takes place in Osaka, Japan and continues ACCV's role as one of the major vision conferences in the region. The conference site highlights topics such as 3D computer vision, autonomous driving, biomedical image analysis, deep learning for vision, face and gesture recognition, image and video analysis, low-level vision, object detection and tracking, scene understanding, vision-language models, video understanding, visual reasoning, and other emerging areas in computer vision.

postings.conferenceName: 2026 11th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 2026 11th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems
postings.conferenceText: The 2026 11th Asia-Pacific Conference on Intelligent Robot Systems (ACIRS 2026) is an annual conference serving as an international forum for developments in intelligent robotic systems and related artificial intelligence methods. The official website presents the conference as a venue for sharing original research and practical advances in robot design, control, applications and intelligent algorithms. The 2026 edition will be held in Hong Kong. The conference emphasizes both foundational robotic technologies and AI-enabled robotic capabilities, particularly in application-oriented and integrated system settings. Robot design and control; robotics applications; intelligent robotic systems; artificial intelligence and robotics; robot perception; motion planning; autonomous systems; mechatronic and robotic integration; robotics and computer-integrated manufacturing; human-robot interaction; intelligent algorithms for robotic applications and related topics in intelligent robot systems.

postings.conferenceName: The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
postings.conferenceText: ACL 2026 is the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, the flagship conference of the ACL community and one of the central venues for natural language processing and computational linguistics. The conference brings together research on language understanding, generation, multilingual NLP, language technologies, and interdisciplinary language-centered AI. The 2026 meeting takes place in San Diego, California. The conference site includes calls spanning the main conference and related activities such as system demonstrations, the student research workshop, workshop proposals, and the industry track. Core topics encompass computational linguistics, natural language understanding and generation, machine translation, information extraction, dialogue, semantics, multilingual NLP, evaluation, and practical language technology systems.

postings.conferenceName: 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia
postings.conferenceText: ACM Multimedia 2026 is the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia, a premier conference dedicated to computing that operates over all forms of media, including video, images, haptics, virtual and augmented reality, audio, speech, music, sensor streams, and social data. The conference highlights multimodal integration, advances in artificial intelligence, 3D and metaverse technologies, vision-language understanding, human-computer interaction, and multimedia signal processing, while also emphasizing application areas such as healthcare, education, and entertainment. The 2026 edition is held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The conference site highlights research on multimedia analysis and understanding; multimodal integration; video, image, audio, speech and music processing; VR/AR and immersive media; 3D media and metaverse technologies; AI for multimedia; vision and language; HCI for multimedia experiences; multimedia systems; and application domains such as healthcare, education and entertainment.

postings.conferenceSeries: The 17th Asian Conference on Machine Learning
postings.conferenceText: ACML 2025 is the 17th Asian Conference on Machine Learning, an annual international conference dedicated to machine learning and closely related fields. Since its launch in 2009, the conference has rotated across major cities in the region and has served as an important forum for methodological advances, theory, algorithms, and applications in machine learning. The 2025 edition is held in Taipei, Taiwan. The conference focuses on machine learning broadly, including statistical learning theory, representation learning, optimization, probabilistic models, sequential decision making, deep learning, and application-driven machine learning research.

postings.conferenceSeries: The 14th Asia Conference on Mechanical and Materials Engineering
postings.conferenceText: ACMME 2026 is the 14th Asia Conference on Mechanical and Materials Engineering and will be held in Osaka, Japan. The conference brings together researchers and engineers from the mechanical engineering and materials engineering communities, with an emphasis on exchanging new theories, technologies, and application-oriented research results. The official site describes the event as an interdisciplinary platform covering core engineering science, advanced materials, processing, manufacturing, and related industrial applications. By integrating both mechanical and materials perspectives, the meeting aims to support collaboration across design, performance, production, and characterization of engineering materials and systems. The call for papers covers mechanical engineering and materials engineering topics such as advanced materials and structures; manufacturing and processing; mechanics and dynamics; design, control and automation; composites, metals, ceramics and polymers; nanomaterials and functional materials; characterization and testing; energy and environmental engineering aspects; and broader application-focused themes included in the ACMME technical program.

postings.conferenceName: First International Conference on AI and Digitalization: A Multidisciplinary Approach (AD’2026)
postings.conferenceSeries: International Conference on AI and Digitalization AD
postings.conferenceText: First International Conference on AI and Digitalization: A Multidisciplinary Approach (AD’2026), taking place fully online on 19–20 December 2026. Organized by: The Arab Group for Higher Education, United Kingdom In partnership with: EuroMid Press, Türkiye We are pleased to invite you to submit your research to the First International Conference on AI and Digitalization: A Multidisciplinary Approach (AD’2026), taking place fully online on 19–20 December 2026. Organized by: The Arab Group for Higher Education, United Kingdom In partnership with: EuroMid Press, Türkiye Conference platform: ConfManage Submission deadline: 30 October 2026 Submit Your Paper through ConfManage Conference Theme Artificial intelligence and digital technologies are transforming education, business, healthcare, engineering, governance, and creative practice. These developments bring significant opportunities alongside complex ethical, social, and professional challenges that require dialogue across disciplines. AD’2026 brings together researchers, academics, practitioners, and policymakers to explore these changes, exchange evidence, and advance responsible and inclusive applications of AI and digitalization. We welcome original research papers, case studies, and review articles offering rigorous analysis, innovative perspectives, and practical insights. Contributions connecting multiple disciplines are particularly encouraged. Why Participate? Open Access publication: Conference proceedings published by EuroMid Press, with a DOI assigned to the volume and each published paper. Journal publication opportunity: Selected high-quality papers will be invited for consideration in a special issue of a Scopus-indexed journal, to be announced. Publication will be subject to the journal’s review and acceptance requirements. Multidisciplinary exchange: Share your research and engage with scholars and professionals across nine thematic tracks. Accessible participation: Join fully online, with reduced fees available for postgraduate students and authors from areas affected by instability. Academic quality: Submissions undergo double-blind peer review managed through ConfManage. Important Dates Milestone Date Paper submission deadline 30 October 2026 Acceptance notification 15 November 2026 Camera-ready submission 30 November 2026 Conference dates 19–20 December 2026 Conference Tracks AI in Education and Digital Learning Smart classrooms, e-learning, digital assessment, personalized learning, and educational data analytics. AI in Accounting, Banking, Business, Economics, Finance, and Management Fintech, business analytics, digital leadership, organizational transformation, and the digital economy. AI in Engineering, Technology, and Computing Robotics, automation, cybersecurity, machine learning, data science, and the Internet of Things. AI in Medicine, Health Sciences, and Public Health Medical diagnosis, telemedicine, hospital management, digital health records, and biotechnology. AI in Arts, Humanities, and Creative Industries Digital humanities, language technologies, media, design, cultural heritage, and AI-driven creativity. AI in Law, Policy, Ethics, and Governance AI regulation, data privacy, cybersecurity law, intellectual property, and algorithmic bias. AI in Social Sciences, Psychology, and Human Behavior Society, communication, identity, mental health, political participation, and digital culture. AI in Environment, Sustainability, and Smart Cities Environmental monitoring, climate data, sustainable development, energy management, and green technology. Interdisciplinary and Future Studies in AI Cross-disciplinary research, theoretical perspectives, innovative models, and emerging directions in AI. Submission Guidelines Manuscripts must be original, unpublished, and not under consideration elsewhere. Papers must be written in English. The maximum paper length is 15 pages, including references and appendices. Authors must follow the formatting guidelines and templates available on the conference website. All submissions will undergo double-blind peer review. Manuscripts must be submitted through the ConfManage platform. Publication Opportunities Accepted papers will be published by EuroMid Press in the Open Access proceedings volume: AI and Digitalization: A Multidisciplinary Approach A Digital Object Identifier (DOI) will be assigned to the proceedings volume and each published paper, supporting discoverability and citation. Selected high-quality papers will also be invited for consideration in a special issue of a Scopus-indexed journal. The journal and submission requirements will be announced separately. Submit Your Research We invite you to contribute to this multidisciplinary exchange on the opportunities, challenges, and future of AI and digitalization. Submit Your Paper via ConfManage Visit the Conference Website Submission deadline: 30 October 2026 Contact Prof. Nabil Hewahi Conference Management Chair & Proceedings Editor Email: [email protected] Dr. Motaz Saad Proceedings Co-Editor Email: [email protected] We look forward to receiving your submissions and welcoming you online to AD’2026. Kind regards, AD’2026 Organizing Committee The Arab Group for Higher Education London, United Kingdom abcdedu.co.uk

postings.conferenceSeries: 37th International Conference on Algorithmic Learning Theory

postings.conferenceName: International Alzheimer’s Disease, Dementia & Cognitive Disorders Conference (ADDC 2027)
postings.conferenceSeries: Alzheimer’s Disease, Dementia & Cognitive Disorders Conference (ADDC 2027)
postings.conferenceText: In its 3rd edition, the 3rd Edition of International Alzheimer's Disease, Dementia & Cognitive Disorders Conference (ADDC 2027) settles at NH Villa Carpegna in Rome from June 24-26, 2027, alongside a virtual channel that opens the meeting to attendees anywhere in the world. Organised by Magnus Group LLC, the Dementia Conference 2027 brings clinicians, neuroscientists, geriatricians, cognitive-disorder specialists, policy advocates, academic researchers, and pharmaceutical innovators into three days of scholarly programme, clinical exchange, and interdisciplinary conversation across Alzheimer's disease, dementia, and cognitive-disorder research. Programme content covers diagnosis and early signs of disease, biomarkers for Alzheimer's and dementia, treatment strategies, cognitive decline and impairment, psychogeriatrics, depression and psychotic symptoms, geriatrics and healthy ageing, immunotherapy and stem-cell approaches, genetics in Alzheimer's and dementia, social and behavioural investigations, the relationship between inflammation and neurodegeneration, and current updates in Alzheimer's and dementia - designed to bring diagnostic, therapeutic, and policy perspectives into a single, coherent conversation. Clinicians, researchers, and geriatric-medicine specialists are warmly invited to contribute original findings, clinical case work, and topical reviews for oral or poster presentation. Delegates and listeners may complete registration on the International Alzheimer's Conference 2027 portal, joining either on-site at NH Villa Carpegna or remotely from any country - both routes are equally supported by the hybrid format. The 2026 edition will be hosted in Darmstadt, Germany, by the Technical University of Darmstadt, continuing the conference’s tradition of bringing together computer scientists, roboticists, biologists, physicists and other researchers interested in swarm-based systems. The official call describes DSD as addressing the full design process, from specification and design methodology to processor architectures, digital circuits, and VLSI implementations. It aims to bring together researchers and engineers from academia and industry working on advanced research, development, and applications in embedded, pervasive, and high-performance systems. The 2026 edition will be held at the AGH University of Kraków, Poland. Beyond the core conference series identity under Euromicro, the conference emphasizes current and future challenges in cyber-physical and embedded systems, design automation, modern implementation technologies, and application-driven innovation across hardware and systems design. Embedded, pervasive and high-performance digital and mixed HW/SW system development; system and processor architectures for embedded and high-performance HW/SW systems; design methodology and design automation for all design levels of embedded, high-performance and cyber-physical systems; modern implementation technologies from full-custom circuits in nanometer technology nodes to FPGAs and MPSoC infrastructures. Main topics listed on the official CFP page include: artificial intelligence from edge to cloud—architectures, methods, tools and applications; design and synthesis of systems, hardware and embedded software—specification, modelling, analysis, validation and testing; design automation at system, processor, register-transfer, logic and physical levels; formal methods in system and hardware design; IoT, cyber-physical, embedded systems and applications; systems-on-a-chip, networks-on-a-chip and systems-in-a-package; high-performance, energy-efficient multi-core and many-core heterogeneous processor architectures; autonomous, adaptable and reconfigurable systems and architectures; security, safety, reliability and multi-objective optimization of embedded and cyber-physical systems; future trends, new applications and new technologies.

postings.conferenceText: ICSE 2027 is the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering, widely regarded as the premier conference in software engineering. Since 1975, the series has provided a central meeting place for researchers, practitioners, and educators working on the methods, tools, processes, and empirical foundations of software development. The 2027 conference is held in Dublin, Ireland and features research and community tracks spanning core software engineering challenges and new directions such as software engineering for AI-enabled systems. Research track areas listed on the conference site include software analytics and mining repositories; visualization; architecture, design and modeling; dependability, resilience, security and privacy; maintenance and evolution; human and social aspects of software engineering; requirements and formal methods; testing, analysis and verification; and software engineering for AI and data-intensive systems.

postings.conferenceName: Sixth International Conference on Sustainable Energy, Environment and Green Technologies 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: ICSEEGT
postings.conferenceText: The Sixth International Conference on Sustainable Energy, Environment and Green Technologies (ICSEEGT 2026) will be held on December 11–12, 2026, in hybrid mode at Poornima College of Engineering, Jaipur, India. The conference provides an international platform for researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and policymakers to share innovative research and practical solutions in renewable and clean energy, environmental engineering, green technologies, sustainability, climate change, circular economy, and sustainable energy materials. ICSEEGT 2026 aims to promote interdisciplinary collaboration, knowledge exchange, innovation, and sustainable technological development addressing global energy and environmental challenges. Track 1 – Renewable and Clean Energy Systems: Renewable energy, solar, wind, hydro and biomass energy; energy storage; hydrogen and fuel cells; alternative fuels and bioenergy; energy efficiency; photovoltaic systems; energy conversion; waste-to-energy; energy forecasting and optimization. Track 2 – Environmental, Pollution and Systems Engineering: Waste treatment; climate change; greenhouse-gas mitigation; air pollution and emission control; environmental impact assessment; sustainable transportation; GIS and remote sensing; environmental modelling; pollution risk assessment; public health and environmental exposure. Track 3 – Green Technologies, Biodiversity and Sustainability: Circular economy; green synthesis; sustainable manufacturing; eco-design; green buildings; biodiversity conservation; life-cycle assessment; net-zero technologies; environmental sustainability; green policy and governance. Track 4 – Sustainable and Functional Energy Materials: Advanced energy materials; sustainable composites; biomaterials; green construction materials; recycling and remanufacturing; waste-derived functional materials; materials for electric and hybrid mobility; hydrogen storage materials; nature-inspired and bio-based materials.

postings.conferenceName: 42nd IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 42nd IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution
postings.conferenceText: ICSME 2026 is the 42nd IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution, a major venue for research on the analysis, evolution, maintenance, and modernization of software systems. The conference brings together academia and industry around techniques, tools, and studies that improve the longevity, quality, and adaptability of software. The 2026 edition in Benevento includes research, industry, tool, replication, registered report, and doctoral tracks spanning both foundational and practical aspects of software evolution. Software maintenance and evolution; program analysis; software modernization and migration; empirical software engineering; testing and quality in evolving systems; technical debt and refactoring; replication and negative results; tools and data showcases; industry perspectives on maintaining and evolving software.

postings.conferenceName: 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence
postings.conferenceText: ICTAI 2026 is the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence, a longstanding conference that brings together researchers and practitioners working on both the foundations of AI and the development of effective AI tools and systems. The conference emphasizes the exchange of ideas between theory and practice, covering methods, platforms, and application domains that push AI into real-world use. The 2026 edition is held in Boca Raton, Florida as an in-person event. The conference site lists topics across AI foundations and applications, including machine learning, knowledge representation, reasoning under uncertainty, planning and decision making, NLP, computer vision, trustworthy and responsible AI, AI systems, AI for big data, smart cities, domain-specific intelligent applications, quantum AI, human-centered AI, and tools that support the engineering and deployment of AI solutions.

postings.conferenceName: 2025 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization 2025
postings.conferenceSeries: 2025 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Visualization
postings.conferenceText: ICVRV is an international conference dedicated to virtual reality, augmented reality, mixed reality, and visualization. The 2025 edition in Bogotá seeks original, high-quality papers covering both theory and technology, together with practical innovations, applications, and experience reports. The conference aims to advance standards and future trends in immersive systems and visualization while encouraging creative, original contributions from across the community. Virtual reality, augmented reality, mixed reality, and visualization; VR/AR/MR input devices; multimodal input and output; human-computer interaction; 2D/3D and volumetric displays; tracking and sensing; computer graphics techniques; theoretical and technological innovations, applications, and practice/experience analyses in immersive and visualization systems.

postings.conferenceName: IEEE International Conference on Web Services 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: IEEE International Conference on Web Services
postings.conferenceText: ICWS 2026 is the IEEE International Conference on Web Services, part of the IEEE World Congress on SERVICES. The conference is a long-running international forum for researchers and industry practitioners working on the fundamentals and practice of Web-based services. It covers modeling, development, discovery, recommendation, composition, testing, adaptation, delivery, and standards for service-oriented systems, along with applications and emerging service technologies. Web services modeling and development; service publishing and discovery; recommendation and composition; service testing and adaptation; service delivery and orchestration; Web services applications and standards; service-oriented computing and related infrastructure.

postings.conferenceName: International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media
postings.conferenceText: ICWSM is a premier venue for research on the interplay of the web and society. Now in its twentieth year, the conference brings together scholars from computational and social science disciplines to study socially relevant questions using digital traces of human behavior. Its scope covers both substantive social questions and the computational methods needed to analyze large, heterogeneous, and often unstructured online and technologically mediated data sources. Web and society; computational social science; social computing; social theory and online behavior; AI, machine learning, network science, text and data mining, NLP, image and multimedia processing; sociology, communication, political science, anthropology, psychology, economics, and digital humanities; research using social media traces, web navigation data, platform data, mobility traces, and other technologically mediated datasets.

postings.conferenceName: 8th Edition of International Conference on Dermatology & Cosmetology 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: Europe Conference
postings.conferenceText: Conference: 8th Edition of International Conference on Dermatology & Cosmetology (IDC 2027) Venue: NH Villa Carpegna, Rome, Italy Dates: June 21-23, 2027 Mode: Hybrid (Onsite + Virtual) Featured as the Dermatology Summit 2027 within specialty listings, this meeting supports evidence-led dialogue between clinical dermatology, aesthetic medicine, and skin-science research - underwriting journal publication, cross-continental collaboration, and industry-academia connection. The Dermatology Symposium 2027 reviews submissions from dermatologists, cosmetic surgeons, trichologists, dermatologic imaging specialists, and aesthetic-medicine practitioners; contributions accepted for review appear in oral or poster sessions with strong indexing visibility. Multi-perspective in design, the programme knits together voices from academic medicine, hospital dermatology, private aesthetic practice, and the medical-device and cosmetics industry. Sessions surface progress across skin microbiome research, dermatologic imaging, tele-dermatology, and nanotechnology-supported skin care - offering attendees a clear view of contemporary dermatology. Rome brings the meeting to a central European setting, while the concurrent online stream extends it to attendees in every region. postings.conferenceName: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data
postings.conferenceText: The 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data is a premier global forum for researchers, practitioners, and developers working on the science, engineering, and applications of big data. Since its launch in 2013, the conference has brought together communities from data mining, machine learning, databases, scalable systems, and real-world analytics. The 2026 edition is held in Phoenix, Arizona and emphasizes interdisciplinary advances across big-data theory, platforms, and deployment-driven research. The conference broadly covers big data analytics, data mining, database systems, machine learning for large-scale data, AI-enabled data applications, scalable and distributed data processing systems, and domain applications that rely on data-intensive methods.

postings.conferenceName: 26th International Conference on Environment and Electrical Engineering 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 26th International Conference on Environment and Electrical Engineering
postings.conferenceText: The IEEE International Conference on Environment and Electrical Engineering (EEEIC) is a long-running conference series at the intersection of electrical engineering, energy systems and environmental issues. The 26th edition will be held in Lisbon in hybrid mode and is presented as a forum for scientists, researchers and practitioners to discuss innovative solutions relevant to modern power systems, energy transition, electrification, environmental monitoring, and sustainable engineering. The official scope and track structure show a broad conference profile, ranging from power transmission and distribution to AI, building systems, sensing, electromobility, sustainability and environmental applications, making it particularly useful for cross-disciplinary work that connects energy engineering with environmental performance and digitalization. Energy infrastructures, smart grids and power systems; renewable energy systems and energy transition; electric machines, drives and power electronics; transmission, distribution and power quality; building technologies and energy efficiency; sensing, measurement and monitoring; electromobility and transportation electrification; industrial applications; artificial intelligence and data-driven engineering; environmental technologies and sustainability; control, automation, materials, ICT and emerging electrical-environmental engineering applications across conference tracks A–N.

postings.conferenceName: IEEE 27th International Conference on Information Reuse and Integration for Data Science 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: IEEE International Conference on Information Reuse and Integration for Data Science
postings.conferenceText: IEEE IRI 2026 is the 27th edition of the International Conference on Information Reuse and Integration for Data Science. The conference focuses on the role of information reuse and integration in modern AI and data science, emphasizing how data, knowledge representations, and reusable computational systems can be combined to support better decision making in real-world settings. The official description highlights IRI as a forum where researchers and practitioners from academia, industry, and government present theoretical and applied work that addresses practical problems with practical solutions. The conference is organized around three major themes—information reuse, information integration, and reusable systems—and continues a long-standing tradition of selective review and interdisciplinary exchange. The 2026 edition will be held in Seattle and includes regular research papers, application and industry papers, short papers, posters, workshops, and plenary talks. Information Integration: multimodal information fusion; information science and theory; AI and security; symbolic AI; hallucination detection and mitigation in AI; novel AI applications in computer vision, computer forensics, security, fake/forgery detection, robotics, recommender systems, and biomedical areas. Information Reuse: data lifecycle reuse; afterlives of data in AI/ML models; preventing model collapse via improved data lineage; knowledge graphs; ontologies, variable alignment, and contextual metadata; cross-domain and multilingual metadata systems; reuse in LLM and AI training data; interoperability and cross-disciplinary reuse; linking datasets from different domains or formats; tools for data transformation and harmonization. Reusable Systems: acceleration of AI system reuse and reuse efficiency; brain-computer interface applications and algorithms; reusable AI for edge and IoT; reusable AI in industry applications; software and systems reuse and reusability; software sustainability and reuse economics; software maintenance and life-cycle management; software reliability, robustness, and dependability; system applications in autonomous vehicles, business, education, engineering, healthcare, IoT, multimedia, NLP, robotics, science, security, social networking, space, and vision.

postings.conferenceName: IEEE VIS 2026 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: IEEE VIS 2026
postings.conferenceText: IEEE VIS 2026 is the year’s premier forum for advances in visualization and visual analytics. The conference convenes an international community of researchers and practitioners from academia, government, and industry to exchange new findings on the theory, methods, design, and use of visualization tools. The 2026 edition returns to the United States and will be held in Boston, continuing the VIS tradition as the flagship event for visualization research. Visualization and visual analytics; theory and methods for visual representation; interactive data analysis; design and evaluation of visualization systems; applications of visualization across domains; tools and practices for effective visual communication and analysis.

postings.conferenceName: 33rd IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 33rd IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces
postings.conferenceText: IEEE VR 2026 is the 33rd IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces, a prestigious international event for research and industrial results in virtual, augmented, and mixed reality. Since 1993, the conference has showcased influential advances by scientists, engineers, designers, and artists working on immersive technologies. The 2026 edition will be hosted in Daegu and continues the conference’s strong focus on VR/AR/MR systems, interaction, and applications. Virtual, augmented, and mixed reality; 3D user interfaces; immersive interaction; rendering and perception; VR/AR/MR systems and applications; interdisciplinary work spanning academia and industry in immersive technology.

postings.conferenceName: 18th International Green Energy Conference (IGEC) & 7th International Conference on Energy and AI 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 18th International Green Energy Conference (IGEC) & 7th International Conference on Energy and AI
postings.conferenceText: The International Green Energy Conference (IGEC) is a long-running international conference series devoted to green energy technologies, sustainable energy systems and, in the 2026 edition, the additional theme of energy and artificial intelligence. The 18th IGEC is hosted in Abu Dhabi and is jointly associated with the 7th International Conference on Energy and AI, reflecting the growing importance of digital and intelligent approaches in future energy systems. The official programme description highlights both technology development and system-level implementation, covering clean energy conversion, storage, carbon management and AI-enabled optimization. The conference is intended for researchers, engineers and practitioners working on advanced energy technologies, sustainability and the transition to low-carbon energy infrastructures. Green energy technologies; energy and artificial intelligence; renewable energy systems; energy storage; hydrogen and advanced fuels; carbon management and decarbonization; smart energy systems; energy conversion and utilization; sustainable engineering applications; policy, implementation and emerging topics identified in the official call for papers.

postings.conferenceName: IJCAI-ECAI 2026, the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: IJCAI-ECAI 2026, the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
postings.conferenceText: IJCAI-ECAI 2026 is the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence, jointly presented in 2026 as IJCAI-ECAI. The conference is one of the major global venues for artificial intelligence research, bringing together work on core AI theory, methodologies, and impactful applications. The 2026 event takes place in Bremen, Germany and features main-track research together with special tracks on societally and technologically important AI directions. The conference covers AI broadly, and the official site specifically highlights special tracks on Human-Centered AI, AI for Social Good, AI4Tech, AI and Health, and AI and Robotics, alongside the broader main-track scope of artificial intelligence research.

postings.conferenceName: 2026 IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 2026 IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics
postings.conferenceText: IJCB 2026 is the 2026 IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics, the flagship conference series of the IEEE Biometrics Council. The conference brings together the communities historically associated with BTAS and ICB and serves as a major international venue for advances in biometric recognition technologies and applications. The 2026 edition in Rome will provide a forum for new work on theory, systems, evaluation, deployment, and broader applications of biometrics in security, identity, and intelligent sensing contexts. Biometric recognition and verification; face, fingerprint, iris, voice and gait biometrics; multimodal biometrics; liveness detection and presentation attack detection; biometric sensing and acquisition; machine learning for biometrics; privacy, fairness and security in biometric systems; benchmarking, evaluation and operational deployment of biometric technologies.

postings.conferenceName: ACM Internet Measurement Conference 2026 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: ACM Internet Measurement Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: IMC 2026 is the ACM Internet Measurement Conference, a leading venue for the collection, analysis, and interpretation of data about the Internet and operational networks. The conference values research that improves the practice of network measurement or deepens understanding of networked systems through sound empirical methods. By combining measurements, methodology, systems insight, and operational relevance, IMC has become a central conference for Internet-scale empirical networking research. Network measurement methodology; Internet traffic measurement and analysis; performance characterization; measurement infrastructure and tools; operational network studies; cloud, CDN and edge measurement; security and privacy measurements; wireless and mobile network measurement; responsible data collection and sharing; empirical studies that illuminate the behavior of real networked systems.

postings.conferenceName: 34th International Materials Research Congress 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 34th International Materials Research Congress
postings.conferenceText: The 34th International Materials Research Congress (IMRC 2026) is a long-running international materials science meeting organized by the Sociedad Mexicana de Materiales in partnership with the Materials Research Society. The congress will be held in Cancún, Mexico and is designed as a broad interdisciplinary forum for the materials research community, with participation from researchers, students, industry representatives, and exhibitors. According to the official meeting information, the event typically brings together a large international audience and is structured around multidisciplinary symposia, a commercial exhibition, and activities such as a graduate fair. The congress covers a wide range of contemporary topics in materials science, engineering, processing, characterization, and advanced technologies, and the 2026 edition offers both on-site and virtual participation modalities. Multidisciplinary materials research symposia; advanced materials design and synthesis; materials characterization and analysis; structural, functional and electronic materials; nanomaterials and low-dimensional systems; energy materials and sustainable technologies; polymers, composites, ceramics and metals; biomaterials and soft materials; materials processing and manufacturing; interfaces, surfaces and thin films; computational and theoretical materials science; emerging materials applications addressed through the congress symposia and associated technical sessions.

Every session is directed at moving research into practice for clinicians, microbiologists, and public-health specialists. Coverage at this Vaccines Conference 2027 reaches across COVID-19 and post-pandemic research, blood infections and sepsis, immunity and inflammation, viral infections, paediatric infectious diseases, antimicrobial resistance, vaccines and virology, ageing-related infectious diseases, public-health response, drug discovery, bacterial, fungal, and parasitic infections, and clinical pharmacology. Delegates and presenters who attend the meeting are given a CPD certificate of attendance; oral or poster abstracts that pass review add further academic recognition. Within the Infectious Diseases Conferences 2027 calendar, this meeting operates a tiered registration model - abstract submission for speakers and presenters, standard or early-bird rates for delegates and listeners. postings.conferenceName: The 21st International Conference on Information Security and Cryptology 2025
postings.conferenceSeries: The 21st International Conference on Information Security and Cryptology
postings.conferenceText: INSCRYPT is an established international conference covering information security, cryptology, and their applications. The 2025 edition in Xi’an invites high-quality papers across both cryptologic and security tracks, and publishes the proceedings in Springer’s LNCS series. The conference positions itself as a broad forum for foundational cryptography, system security, privacy, network and cloud security, and practical security applications, while also featuring keynote talks from leading researchers. Cryptologic track: foundations of cryptography; provable security; Boolean functions; secure multiparty computation; symmetric and public-key cryptosystems; implementation; hash functions and MACs; key management; protocol analysis; information hiding; secure outsourcing; verifiable computation; obfuscation; leakage resilience. Security track: access control; authentication and authorization; biometric security; distributed and mobile system security; e-commerce security; intrusion detection; network security; security architectures; malware detection; privacy-enhancing technologies; genomic privacy; SDN security; big data and cloud security.

postings.conferenceName: 17th International Conference on Internetware 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 17th International Conference on Internetware
postings.conferenceText: Internetware 2026 is the 17th edition of the International Conference on Internetware, a forum devoted to software technologies for Internet-centric, cloud-enabled, and highly connected systems. The conference positions itself as a venue for research on the engineering principles, platforms, and applications required for modern Internetware systems, including dynamically evolving services, software ecosystems, and intelligent networked applications. The 2026 program includes research, tool demonstration, and new idea tracks, reflecting the conference’s long-standing role in bridging foundational software engineering research with emerging Internet-scale computing practice. Internetware foundations and architectures; software engineering for cloud, web and service ecosystems; software evolution and adaptation; AI-enabled software systems; distributed, edge and mobile Internet applications; software trustworthiness, reliability, testing and verification; DevOps, deployment and operations for Internet-scale systems; tool demonstrations and new ideas related to Internet-centric software engineering.

postings.conferenceSeries: International Symposium on Bioinformatics Research and Applications
postings.conferenceText: ISBRA brings together researchers and professionals working in bioinformatics and computational biology. Bioinformatics and computational biology; biomarker discovery; high-performance biocomputing; biomedical databases and data integration; biomedical text mining and ontologies; molecular evolution; biomolecular imaging; molecular modeling and simulation; spatial omics; systems biology; structural biology and drug discovery; AI and machine learning tools in medical bioinformatics; big data analytics in biology and medicine; bioinformatics education and public engagement; metagenomics; population genetics; computational epidemiology.

postings.conferenceSeries: 53rd International Symposium on Computer Architecture
postings.conferenceText: ISCA 2026 is the 53rd International Symposium on Computer Architecture, one of the premier forums for new ideas and experimental results in computer architecture. The conference emphasizes particularly forward-looking and novel submissions, bringing together the architecture community around foundational advances and emerging hardware-system directions. The 2026 edition is held at the Raleigh Convention Center in Raleigh, USA. The conference focuses on computer architecture broadly, including processor and accelerator architecture, memory systems, system architecture, hardware/software co-design, performance, efficiency, reliability, and experimental studies that advance the state of the art in computing systems.

postings.conferenceSeries: 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems
postings.conferenceText: ISCAS is the flagship conference of the IEEE Circuits and Systems Society and one of the world’s premier forums for the theory, design, and implementation of circuits and systems. The 2026 edition is built around the theme ‘Circuits and Systems for Intelligent Society’ and promotes research at the intersection of circuits, systems, and artificial intelligence. Its program includes technical sessions, posters, special sessions, tutorials, workshops, and publication opportunities linked to the broader IEEE CAS community. Circuits and systems theory, design, and implementation; artificial intelligence and deep learning; smart automotive systems; neurotechnologies; intelligent cyber security systems; food security and climate change applications; ultra-low-power circuits and systems; special sessions, demonstrations, tutorials, workshops, and cross-society initiatives.

postings.conferenceText: ISMAR 2026 is the 25th IEEE International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality, the leading global venue for AR, MR, and closely related VR research. The 2026 edition in Bari continues ISMAR’s role as a flagship international forum for mixed and augmented reality. Mixed, augmented, and virtual reality; immersive systems and interaction; tracking and registration; rendering and perception; user experience and evaluation; collaborative and industrial XR; AR/MR hardware and software systems; applications of immersive technologies.

postings.conferenceSeries: International Conference on Innovation Structure and Resilient City (ISRC 2026)
postings.conferenceText: SCOPUS-The 2nd International Conference on Innovation Structure and Resilient City (ISRC 2026) https://www.icisrc.org/ August 22–24, 2026 | Bangkok, Thailand Conference Introduction The 2nd International Conference on Innovative Structure and Resilient City (ISRC 2026) will be held in Bangkok, Thailand, bringing together leading researchers, engineers, urban planners, and industry experts from around the world. In an era marked by accelerating climate risks, rapid urbanization, infrastructure aging, and increasing disaster uncertainty, resilient cities have become a global research priority. ISRC 2026 provides a high-level international platform to present cutting-edge research and practical solutions for next-generation urban systems, resilient infrastructure, and sustainable city development. Following the success of the inaugural ISRC 2025 in Nagoya, Japan, the proceedings was published in E3S Web of Conferences (Vol. 653) and successfully indexed in Scopus, demonstrating the academic quality and international visibility of the series. ISRC 2026 continues to strengthen its role as a recognized international academic venue for interdisciplinary research on structural innovation and urban resilience. Publication All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous peer-review process conducted by the conference committees. Accepted and presented papers will be included in the ISRC 2026 conference proceedings and published in the E3S Web of Conferences. The publisher will submit the proceedings to Scopus for indexing. Important Dates Submission Deadline: July 3, 2026 Notification of Acceptance: July 13, 2026 Registration Due: July 20, 2026 Conference Date: August 22-24, 2026 Submission Method Submit by Openconf system: https://www.icisrc.org/openconf/openconf.php Email: [email protected] Note: Please choose one of the ways to contribute Contact Us Conference Secretary: Ms. Ji Email: [email protected] Tel: +86-15618780723 Wechat: spec1119 Website: https://www.icisrc.org/ Conference Theme The conference topics include but are not limited to: T1: Smart Structures and Infrastructure for Resilient City T2: Sustainable Architecture and Health Monitoring T3: Resilience Evaluation and Assessment Methodologies T4: Urban Resilience Design, Climate Change Adaptation and Engineering Applications T5: Urban Data Analytics and Digital Twins for City Planning T6: Urban Resilience-Based Management and Policy More session topics here: https://www.icisrc.org/cfp.html

postings.conferenceName: 2026 12th International Symposium on Sensors, Mechatronics and Automation System 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 2026 12th International Symposium on Sensors, Mechatronics and Automation System
postings.conferenceText: The 2026 12th International Symposium on Sensors, Mechatronics and Automation System (ISSMAS 2026) is an international symposium focused on recent research in sensors, mechatronics and automation systems. The official website notes that the series has been successfully held in prior editions and aims to provide a platform for researchers, engineers and scholars to exchange ideas and present developments in these closely related areas. The 2026 event will be held in Wuhan, China. Its scope connects sensing technologies, intelligent mechanical systems and automation-oriented applications, making it relevant to both academic researchers and practitioners working in modern smart systems. Sensors; mechatronics; automation systems; sensing technologies; intelligent mechanical systems; automation and control related topics; interdisciplinary research connecting sensors, mechatronic design and automation-oriented applications.

postings.conferenceName: 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering
postings.conferenceText: ISSRE 2026 is the 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering, a longstanding venue for cutting-edge research on software reliability and dependability. Over the years, ISSRE has become a global forum for presenting advances that improve the reliability, quality, assurance, and resilience of software systems. The 2026 edition in Limassol brings together ideas from both academia and industry and includes multiple tracks such as research, industry, doctoral, and replication-oriented contributions. Software reliability engineering; dependability and assurance; testing, verification, and analysis for reliability; empirical studies of software quality; industrial reliability practices; replication and negative results; tools, artifacts, and project highlights related to reliable software systems.

postings.conferenceName: ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis
postings.conferenceText: ISSTA 2026 is the ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis, a leading research symposium on software testing and analysis. It brings together academics, industrial researchers, and practitioners to exchange ideas, experience, and new results on techniques for analyzing and testing software systems. The 2026 edition marks the 35th ISSTA and is co-located with SPLASH/ISSTA 2026 in Oakland. Software testing; dynamic and static analysis; automated debugging and repair; symbolic execution and fuzzing; test generation and prioritization; reliability and security testing; empirical evaluation of testing and analysis techniques; tools and industrial practice in software testing and analysis.

postings.conferenceName: 25th International Semantic Web Conference 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 25th International Semantic Web Conference
postings.conferenceText: ISWC 2026 is the 25th International Semantic Web Conference, a flagship venue for semantic technologies, knowledge representation, and web-scale intelligent information systems. The conference gathers researchers and practitioners working on knowledge graphs, linked data, ontologies, reasoning, and semantic applications across academia and industry. The 2026 edition in Bari continues ISWC’s role in connecting symbolic knowledge technologies with AI-driven and data-centric systems. Semantic Web; knowledge graphs; linked data; ontologies and ontology engineering; reasoning and inference; semantic data integration; schema alignment and entity linking; semantic search and question answering; industrial and in-use semantic applications; semantic technologies for AI and data-driven systems.

postings.conferenceName: International Test Conference 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: International Test Conference
postings.conferenceText: ITC 2026 is the International Test Conference, a major venue for electronic test, reliability, and validation technologies across the lifecycle of integrated circuits and systems. The conference addresses the technical and practical challenges of testing increasingly complex hardware, from design-for-test and manufacturing test through diagnosis, security, and in-field dependability. Its program traditionally connects academic advances with industrial practice in semiconductor test and quality assurance. Design-for-test; manufacturing test; diagnosis and yield learning; reliability and aging; silicon debug; test compression and BIST; hardware security and trust; memory test and repair; validation and post-silicon verification; automotive, safety-critical and system-level test.

postings.conferenceName: The 3rd International Symposium on Intelligent Technology for Future Transportation 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: UK conference on Transportation
postings.conferenceText: The 3rd International Symposium on Intelligent Technology for Future Transportation (ITFT 2026) will be held in Glasgow, UK, from October 20-22, 2026 (hybrid). Following the successful editions of ITFT 2024 in Helsinki, Finland and ITFT 2025 in London, United Kingdom, this conference will continue to bring together distinguished scholars from around the world in the field of intelligent transportation to deliver keynote and invited speeches, as well as oral & poster presentations. The conference aims to continue the legacy of fostering innovation and collaboration in the field of intelligent transportation, and to create a smarter, greener, and more interconnected transportation landscape. T1：Intelligent Vehicle Technology and Applications T2：Intelligent Transportation Management T3：Advanced Technology for Public Transportation T4：Design and implementation of Intelligent Transportation Infrastructure T5：Other Intelligent Technology for Transportation

postings.conferenceName: The 2nd International Symposium on Intelligent Technologies for Smart Agriculture 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: International Symposium on Intelligent Technologies for Smart Agriculture
postings.conferenceText: The 2nd International Symposium on Intelligent Technologies for Smart Agriculture (ITSA 2026) will be held in Bangkok, Thailand from August 21-23, 2026. Following the success of the inaugural event held in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia in September 2025, this conference aims to provide an open and innovative communication platform for global experts, scholars, researchers, and industry practitioners to explore cutting-edge developments, challenges, and opportunities in smart agriculture and intelligent technology, fostering digital transformation and sustainable agricultural development. The conference will cover multiple research hotspots, from agricultural intelligent perception and decision support, to precision animal farming and smart planting, to big data-driven supply chain management and climate adaptive agricultural solutions. ITSA 2026 warmly welcomes experts, researchers, and practitioners from across the globe to contribute to this vital dialogue, fostering innovations that shape a sustainable and technology-driven future for agriculture. The accepted and registered papers will be featured in ITSA 2026 Conference Proceedings. The proceedings will be published under Springer's esteemed "Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems" series. Furthermore, all contributions will be submitted for inclusion in prominent databases such as EI Compendex and Scopus. T1: Models and Algorithms for Smart Agriculture T2: Agricultural Sensors, Robotics and Automation T3: Smart Livestock and Precision Animal Farming T4: Agricultural Big Data and Supply Chain T5: Smart Technologies for Sustainable and Resilient Agriculture

postings.conferenceName: ACM Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: ACM Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces
postings.conferenceText: IUI 2026 is the ACM Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces, a premier venue at the intersection of artificial intelligence and human-computer interaction. The conference highlights research on how intelligent computational techniques can augment, adapt, and transform interactive systems and user experiences. The 2026 edition in Cyprus continues IUI’s role as a core forum for AI-enabled interface design, evaluation, and deployment. Intelligent user interfaces; AI in human-computer interaction; adaptive and personalized interfaces; interactive machine learning; multimodal and conversational interaction; user modeling; evaluation of intelligent interactive systems; applications that combine AI techniques with interface innovation.

postings.conferenceName: IEEE JointCloud Computing Conference 2026 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: IEEE JointCloud Computing Conference 2026
postings.conferenceText: JCC 2026 is the IEEE JointCloud Computing Conference, a forum for researchers and practitioners to exchange innovative ideas on JointCloud systems and next-generation cloud computing. The 2026 edition is organized as a hybrid event in Tokyo and highlights the convergence of distributed cloud infrastructure with advanced AI models, including LLMs and generative AI. The conference is intended to connect systems research, platform design, and emerging application demands in collaborative cloud environments. JointCloud architectures and platforms; distributed and hybrid cloud systems; cloud management and orchestration; AI infrastructure, LLMs and generative AI on cloud platforms; performance, scalability and reliability; data management and storage for cloud systems; security and privacy; edge-cloud collaboration; cloud-native applications and services.

postings.conferenceName: 30th International Conference on Knowledge-Based and Intelligent Information & Engineering Systems 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 30th International Conference on Knowledge-Based and Intelligent Information & Engineering Systems
postings.conferenceText: KES 2026, the 30th International Conference on Knowledge-Based and Intelligent Information & Engineering Systems, is a long-running international conference organized by KES International. The official conference materials describe it as a forum covering a broad spectrum of intelligent systems research, with emphasis on knowledge-based methods, intelligent information processing and engineering applications. The 2026 edition is scheduled to take place in Dublin, Ireland. The conference typically attracts work spanning theory, computational methods and practical systems in intelligent engineering, reflecting its broad and interdisciplinary orientation. Knowledge-based systems; intelligent information systems; intelligent data processing; symbolic representations, rules and logic; ontologies and semantic systems; hybrid intelligent systems; machine learning and computational intelligence; decision support; intelligent agents; engineering applications of intelligent systems; data-driven and knowledge-driven methods; information engineering and related intelligent technologies.

postings.conferenceName: 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning
postings.conferenceText: KR 2026 is the 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning, the leading forum for research in knowledge representation and reasoning within artificial intelligence. The conference covers formal and computational approaches to representing knowledge, drawing inferences, and connecting symbolic reasoning with broader AI and systems areas. The 2026 edition is held in Lisbon, Portugal as part of FLoC 2026, with workshops around the main dates. The conference welcomes work on the principles of knowledge representation and reasoning and highlights links with planning, robotics, natural language processing, machine learning, data management, the semantic web, verification, and software engineering. The site also lists special tracks such as KR Meets ML and Explanation, and KR in the Wild.

postings.conferenceName: 19th International Conference on Knowledge Science, Engineering and Management 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 19th International Conference on Knowledge Science, Engineering and Management
postings.conferenceText: KSEM 2026 is the 19th International Conference on Knowledge Science, Engineering and Management. The conference focuses on research and practice in knowledge representation, engineering, management, and intelligent information processing, and serves as an international forum for scholars and practitioners in related areas. The 2026 edition will be held in Beijing and continues the KSEM series as a venue for interdisciplinary work connecting AI, knowledge technologies, and management applications. Knowledge science and engineering; knowledge representation and reasoning; knowledge management; intelligent information processing; AI-enabled knowledge services; data, semantics, and decision support; applications of knowledge technologies in science, engineering, and management.

postings.conferenceName: 51st IEEE Conference on Local Computer Networks 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 51st IEEE Conference on Local Computer Networks
postings.conferenceText: LCN 2026 is the 51st IEEE Conference on Local Computer Networks, a long-running international conference on the theory and practice of computer networking. The conference covers networking architectures, protocols, measurements, and applications, with particular attention to modern wired, wireless, and edge-connected environments. Its long history and broad technical scope make it an established forum for both foundational and systems-oriented networking research. Local and wireless networks; network protocols and architectures; network performance and measurement; IoT and sensor networking; edge and cloud-connected networking; network security and privacy; software-defined networking and network management; dependable and resilient communication systems; emerging applications and services over computer networks.

postings.conferenceName: 41st Annual Symposium on Logic in Computer Science 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 41st Annual Symposium on Logic in Computer Science
postings.conferenceText: LICS 2026 is the 41st Annual Symposium on Logic in Computer Science and will be held in Lisbon as part of FLoC 2026. The symposium is an annual international forum on theoretical and practical topics in computer science that relate to logic, broadly construed. LICS connects logic with programming languages, verification, semantics, complexity, and other core areas of theoretical computer science. Logic in computer science; proof theory and type theory; semantics and verification; automata and formal languages; complexity and descriptive complexity; logical methods in programming languages and systems; applications of logic across theoretical and practical computer science.

postings.conferenceName: International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis
postings.conferenceText: Introduction We are pleased to welcome you to the 7th International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2026), which will take place in Edinburgh, United Kingdom, from October 22 to 24, 2026. Over the past six editions—Oxford (2020), Birmingham (2021), Leicester (2022), Cambridge (2023), Manchester (2024), and London (2025)—MICAD has established itself as a leading international forum in Europe, bringing together researchers, clinicians, engineers, and industry professionals from around the world to exchange ideas and advance the field of medical imaging and computer-aided diagnosis. MICAD 2026 aims to foster high-level academic exchange on multimodal medical image intelligent analysis, medical imaging foundation models, trustworthy and explainable artificial intelligence, intelligent computer-aided diagnosis systems, and the deep integration of medical imaging with clinical decision-making and precision medicine. The conference will feature a comprehensive and dynamic technical program, including Keynote and invited speeches delivered by internationally recognized experts. In addition, Oral and Poster Sessions will present cutting-edge research findings, methodological innovations, and clinically relevant applications. To recognize excellence, Best Paper Awards will be presented, and participants will benefit from valuable networking opportunities with leading academics, clinicians, and industry innovators. Publication All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous peer-review process facilitated by our conference committees. Accepted and presented papers will be featured in the MICAD 2026 Conference Proceedings which will be published with Springer in their "Lecture Notes in Electrical Engineering (LNEE)" (ISSN: 1876-1100). Furthermore, the proceedings will be submitted for indexing to prominent databases including EI-Compendex, SCOPUS, and Springerlink. postings.conferenceName: 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention
postings.conferenceText: MICCAI 2026 is the 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention, one of the leading conferences at the intersection of medical imaging, computer vision, machine learning, and computer-assisted interventions. The conference brings together methodological advances and clinically relevant applications in image analysis, image-guided procedures, and computational medicine. The 2026 event is held in Abu Dhabi, with satellite events surrounding the main conference program. The conference centers on medical image computing and computer-assisted intervention, including image segmentation and registration, computer-aided diagnosis, surgical data science, image-guided therapy, learning for medical imaging, multimodal and longitudinal analysis, intervention planning, navigation and robotics, and translational clinical applications.

postings.conferenceName: Ninth Annual Conference on Machine Learning and Systems 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: Ninth Annual Conference on Machine Learning and Systems
postings.conferenceText: MLSys 2026 is the ninth annual Conference on Machine Learning and Systems, a major venue at the intersection of machine learning and systems. The conference highlights research that advances the infrastructure, algorithms, and tools needed to train, deploy, optimize, and evaluate modern ML workloads. The 2026 edition in Bellevue continues MLSys’s strong emphasis on bridging ML methods with systems design, hardware, software, and operational concerns. Efficient training and inference for machine learning; LLM training, fine-tuning, and inference; compound AI systems; distributed and federated learning; privacy and security in ML systems; scheduling and resource management; testing and debugging of ML systems; fairness and explainability with systems implications; data preparation pipelines; programming models, compilers, visualization tools, specialized hardware, and benchmarks for ML systems.

postings.conferenceName: 33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling 2027
postings.conferenceSeries: 33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling
postings.conferenceText: MMM 2027 is the 33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling, a well-established international forum for research on the modeling, analysis, retrieval, generation, and applications of multimedia data. The conference brings together work from multimedia systems, content understanding, user interaction, and emerging multimedia applications, and has built a long series history across Asia and beyond. The 2027 edition is held in Siem Reap, Cambodia. The conference addresses multimedia modeling and related areas, including multimedia analysis and retrieval, video and image understanding, multimodal learning, content generation, user interaction, systems for multimedia applications, demonstrations, special sessions, workshop activities, and forward-looking ideas in new multimedia directions.

postings.conferenceName: The 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking
postings.conferenceText: MobiCom 2026 is the 32nd Annual International Conference on Mobile Computing and Networking, a highly selective premier international forum dedicated to challenges in mobile computing and wireless and mobile networking. Sponsored by ACM SIGMOBILE, the conference covers networks, systems, algorithms, and applications that support mobile devices and wireless networks. The 2026 edition takes place in Austin, Texas and also includes workshops, research demonstrations, and a poster session with the ACM Student Research Competition. The conference addresses mobile computing and networking broadly, including mobile and wireless systems, networking protocols, algorithms for mobility and wireless environments, platforms and applications for mobile systems, experimental and deployment-driven studies, and supporting demonstrations, workshops, and poster activities.

postings.conferenceName: The 27th International Symposium on Theory, Algorithmic Foundations, and Protocol Design for Mobile Networks and Mobile Computing 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 27th International Symposium on Theory, Algorithmic Foundations, and Protocol Design for Mobile Networks and Mobile Computing
postings.conferenceText: MobiHoc 2026 is the 27th ACM International Symposium on Theory, Algorithmic Foundations, and Protocol Design for Mobile Networks and Mobile Computing. The symposium is a leading forum for fundamental and systems-oriented research on mobile, wireless, and networked computing, with strong emphasis on rigorous models, algorithms, and experimentally grounded protocol and system design. Its scope spans both theoretical advances and practically motivated innovations for next-generation mobile and pervasive systems. Mobile ad hoc and wireless networks; protocol design and analysis; algorithmic foundations of mobile computing; sensing and IoT systems; edge and pervasive computing; network optimization and resource management; localization, mobility modeling and tracking; security, privacy and trust in mobile systems; experimental evaluation and systems for mobile and wireless computing.

postings.conferenceName: The 24th ACM International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services 2026
postings.conferenceSeries: The 24th ACM International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services
postings.conferenceText: MobiSys 2026 is the 24th ACM International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services.
